notes.title: Some big changes coming up and update 140 is up and AMA.
notes.notes:
-Fixed a glitch while changing scenes in which the game will freeze if the CPU or GPU was at max.
-Added support for 16x10 aspect ratio, it's not fully implemented but the majority is there.
-Ui fixes everywhere... changing from 16x9 to 16x10 was a mess.

and we were primarily working on some other things... which are secret and you'll never get away from me...
